claim_boundary: External object-held-out Deform360 trajectory-displacement transfer on fresh sheet and volumetric objects only. This is not a filament result, official Deform360 Table-4 parity, a physical simulator-state correction, a state-of-the-art claim, or authorization to open the historically reserved Deform360 target cohort.

group_calibration.object_q90_interpretation: Across-object conformal quantile of each calibration object's registered 90th percentile NEES ratio within each horizon.
group_calibration.simultaneous_interpretation: Across-object conformal quantile of each calibration object's maximum NEES ratio within each horizon.

normalized_evidence.component_bank: frozen historical 5 x 3 process/observation standard-deviation grid
normalized_evidence.mean_rule: component log evidence divided by each track's supported prefix-observation count
normalized_evidence.weight_rule: softmax(log prior plus mean log evidence per supported observation)

selection.historical_exclusions: union of the frozen V1 open_or_reserved list, V1/V2 calibration cohorts, V1/V2 reserved target cohorts, and explicit prior-path-open objects
selection.object_rule: SHA-256 rank within the frozen V1 name-only deformation stratum among mounted objects with a named episode and NPZ candidate path
